The '''LPL 2020 Summer Split''' was the second split of the 2020 season  '''LoL Pro League''' (''LPL''), organized by TJ Sports, running from June 5 to August 27 across multiple cities in China. Due to ongoing COVID-19 restrictions, the league operated in a controlled offline environment with teams playing from designated home-venue hubs in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Suzhou, Xi’an, Chengdu, and Beijing rather than hosting a centralized studio season. Travel protocols, controlled audience access, and health-screening measures remained in place throughout the split.

The Regular Season used a single round robin with all matches played as best-of-three, followed by a single-elimination Playoffs bracket. The champion secured qualification to the [[World Championship/2020|World Championship]], with additional Championship Points awarded based on final placement.

==Format==
*'''Group Stage''' 
** Single round robin, {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd and 4th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th till 8th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''9th till 17th place''}} are eliminated from this split.
****1st, 4th, 5th, and 8th seed will be in one bracket. The other 4 seeds will be in the other.
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2020|Worlds 2020]]
*** 5th and 6th will be determined by total match differential in Summer Season Group Stage and Summer Playoffs
